title: KM VMS 0.8.2 — Candidate Lineage Handoff Fix
summary: Uses the downloaded target release lineage during legacy bridge preflight, preventing a valid skipped-release update from being rejected by the older installed lineage.
changelog: Resolves the bridge lineage from the downloaded target source before falling back to the installed working directory.
Prevents stale installed lineage from falsely rejecting a valid source version already supported by the target release.
Preserves the existing fallback for environments where the bridge has no adjacent candidate lineage file.
Adds a subprocess regression test with deliberately stale installed lineage and current candidate lineage.
Does not change database schema, stored data, service topology, permissions or the planned Stage 6.6.1 rollback architecture.
